app.tagline: See, understand and manage all your AI coding projects.

workspace.localHint: Projects on this computer. Private by default.

stop.title: Emergency stop
stop.body: This stops every running agent, scheduled job and remote command right away.

palette.placeholder: What do you want to do?

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyBody: God Eye finds your projects automatically from your Claude Code sessions. Start a session in any project and it appears here.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.emptyBody: Approvals, mentions and alerts will show up here.

placeholder.body: This page is planned. See plan.md for the details.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Turkish and English are ready. Other languages will be prepared for you the first time you pick them.
settings.modeSimpleHint: Only what you need, in plain words.
settings.keymapVimHint: j/k to move, gg/G to jump, / to search.
settings.systemHint: Tools God Eye can use on this computer.
settings.autoSummarizeHint: Finished sessions are summarized in plain words with a small, cheap model on your own account.
settings.toneHint: Plain is for anyone; technical names files, functions and tools.

onboarding.readyBody: God Eye runs only on your computer. Nothing leaves it unless you decide to share.

project.noReports: No reports yet. They are written automatically for days with activity, or you can ask for one now.
project.renameHint: Only changes the name shown in God Eye.

memory.title: Project memory
memory.hint: What God Eye remembers about this project. It is given to every new AI session, so the AI starts from the facts instead of guessing.
memory.empty: Nothing remembered yet. Memory fills in as sessions get summarized.
memory.addPlaceholder: Something every AI session should know…
memory.conflictBody: A newer session said something different. Which one is right?

setup.hooksTitle: Give new sessions the project memory
setup.hooksBody: Adds a small hook to this project's local Claude Code settings. Every new session then starts with the memory above. Your repo is not changed: the file stays out of git.

session.noSummaryBody: This session has no summary yet. God Eye can write one in plain words.
session.missing: Edited files that no longer exist
session.missingHint: The AI changed these files, but they are not on disk anymore. They may have been moved or deleted.
session.older: Only the latest messages are shown.
session.claims: Said it worked, right after a failure
session.claimsHint: The AI said this right after a step failed. Check it before you trust it.
session.packagesHint: Checked against the public registry (npm, PyPI).
session.pkgWarn: AI sometimes invents package names, and attackers publish packages with those names. Check this one before using it.
session.inView: What the AI has in view
session.inViewHint: Files it read or changed most recently.
session.memoryOn: Project memory was given at start
session.memoryOff: Project memory is not given to sessions (turn it on in Setup)
session.mentioned: Files the AI mentioned that don't exist
session.mentionedHint: The AI wrote these paths in its answers, but there is no such file in the project. It may have made them up.

health.title: Session health
health.contextHint: How full the AI's working memory is. Above 80% it starts to forget earlier details.
health.fresh: This session is tired. Starting a new one with a summary will give better, more reliable answers.
health.compact: Half of the AI's working memory is used. Typing /compact in this session now keeps it sharp for longer.

git.title: Code flow
git.behind: Others pushed {{count}} commits you don't have. Pull before you start, so your work doesn't collide.
git.ahead: {{count}} of your commits are not pushed yet. Others can't see them.
git.changed: {{count}} changes aren't committed. Commit them before switching tasks or deploying.
git.noUpstream: This branch isn't connected to a remote branch yet.

ask.action: Ask AI about your past work
ask.noAnswer: Nothing in your sessions answers this.

mcp.title: God Eye tools inside Claude
mcp.hint: Lets Claude look up project memory and past sessions by itself, in every project.

term.title: Terminals
term.emptyBody: Start a Claude, Codex or shell session from any project. It keeps running even if you close this page.
term.forkHint: Starts a new branch of this conversation; the original stays as it is.
term.freshHint: Opens a new session that already knows what was done and what is left.
term.handToHint: Continue this work in {{tool}} with a summary of what was done and what is left.

code.conflict: This file changed on disk while you were editing. Reload to see the new version.
code.pickFile: Pick a file on the left
code.binary: This file can't be shown as text.

files.title: Files
files.name: Name
files.addFolderHint: Full path of a folder God Eye may open
files.protected: Protected folders like ~/.ssh are never shown.

preview.explainAsk: Explain this file in plain words: what is it for and what's important in it?
preview.summarizeAsk: Summarize this file in 3-5 short bullet points.
preview.askSelectionQ: Explain this code in plain words.

quick.title: Quick question
quick.hint: Ask anything without touching your main session.
quick.fullHint: Uses everything the session saw (slower, uses more of your limit).
quick.explainFile: What does this file do? Explain it in plain words.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.empty: No ideas yet. Press Ctrl+I anywhere to drop one.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.empty: No saved prompts. Save the ones that work well and reuse them in one click.
prompts.bodyHint: Use {name} for blanks you fill in each time, e.g. {file} or {feature}.

servers.title: Servers
servers.emptyBody: Add a server you reach with ssh. God Eye uses your own ssh and ssh-agent; it never reads your keys.
servers.name: Name
servers.targetHint: user@host, a host name, or an alias from ~/.ssh/config
servers.riskHint_danger: Can delete data or take the server down. Needs a double confirmation.
servers.confirmDanger: Type the server name to confirm
servers.hostKey: First connection to this server: open the SSH terminal once and accept its host key, then check again.

approvals.title: Waiting for your approval
approvals.dangerCheck: I understand this can't be undone

chat.title: Chat
chat.placeholder: Ask Claude to do something… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.modeHint_normal: Every step that changes something waits for your OK.
chat.modeHint_acceptEdits: File edits go through; commands still ask.
chat.modeHint_auto: Claude decides what is safe; risky steps still ask.
chat.modeHint_plan: Claude only plans; nothing is changed.
chat.emptyBody: Claude works in this project's folder. Steps that change things wait for your approval.

checkpoint.title: Snapshots
checkpoint.hint: God Eye saves your code before every AI step. Go back to any of them.
checkpoint.restoreBody: These files will be put back as they were. Your current state is saved first, so you can undo this.

limits.title: Limits
limits.subtitle: How much of your AI limits is used, where, and when.
limits.noData: No limit reading yet. It appears after the next Claude reply in God Eye (chat, quick question or a summary).
limits.fullAt: At this pace it fills at {{time}}.
limits.safe: At this pace it lasts until the reset.
limits.switchHint: Close to the limit: switch to another account for new sessions, or hand the work over to Codex.
limits.tokensHint: Counted: new input, output and cache writes (cache reads are left out).

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.label: Name
accounts.loginHint: A terminal opens with the tool's login. Finish it there, then press Check.
accounts.noSwitch: God Eye never switches accounts on its own; you choose.
